name: classify
expr: [cL, errL, postL, logpL] = classify(sample, training, group); [cQ, errQ] = classify(sample, training, group, 'quadratic'); [cDL] = classify(sample, training, group, 'diaglinear'); [cDQ] = classify(sample, training, group, 'diagquadratic');
comment: Sig: [class, err, posterior, logp] = classify(sample, training, group[, type]). 4 discriminant types: linear (LDA, default), quadratic (QDA), diaglinear, diagquadratic. Empirical priors n_k/N. Cholesky-factor approach for numerical stability. Mahalanobis type DEFERRED.
